## Why it matters

islandskort.is provides digitized historical maps grouped by period and cartographic tradition, with contextual notes on major map series and survey campaigns.

For research on Iceland and the North Atlantic, it is a strong primary-source portal for studying changing geographical knowledge and mapmaking practices.
